title: Native library decisions
description: One entry per direct native dependency that check-native-libraries.mjs classifies as interop (legacy architecture code run through React Native's interop layer), or whose classification the app overrides with evidence.

architecture.description: interop: the package ships legacy architecture code and runs through the interop layer. new: the package is native on the New Architecture although the checker classifies it otherwise (for example a JSI library without codegenConfig), or it is excluded from expo-doctor's directory check; the evidence says which.

decision.description: keep: the app ships it on the interop layer for now. replace: a move to replaceWith is planned.

reason.description: Why the app needs this package now.

evidence.description: What was checked and where: the React Native Directory entry, the library's issue, the screens tested on an iOS simulator and an Android emulator.

recheckBy.description: The date by which the entry is checked again (the interop layer is scheduled for removal; every SDK move is a recheck too).

replaceWith.description: The package or local module that replaces it (decision replace).
